Type: floating wall shelf
Use: displaying books and decor on a wall; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, glam, art deco
Materials: natural wood plank, gold metal brackets
Colors: warm medium wood, gold
Shape: long slim plank on two curved scroll brackets, simple and light, slim profile
Feel: elegant, warm, light
Goes with: white or dark walls, brass accents, plants; modern or glam rooms

product.name: Rivet Modern Curved Frame Floating Wall Shelf - 7.5 Inch, Gold and Natural Wood (Renewed)
product.description: This modern shelving unit is a great way to add an extra dimension to your wall decorations. The solid-fir shelf sits atop a gold-colored iron frame and 4 golden arches, which strengthen the shelf visually and structurally. 7.48"H x 25"W x 6.5"D 90% fir; 10% iron Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
